facts.claim: (search-result snippet from music.apple.com) 'Kiss The Rain' is listed as a song by Yiruma (piano) on the album SOLO, release date July 30, 2021.

(search-result snippet from music.apple.com) 'Kiss The Rain' is also listed as an album by Yiruma, dated August 7, 2024, phonographic line '(P) 2026 UMG Recordings, Inc.' (a later release, not the original).

(search-result snippet from music.apple.com) 'River Flows In You' by Yiruma is listed on Apple Music Classical as an Editor's Choice work page showing a Yiruma recording dated 2021; original release year not shown.
(search-result snippet from music.apple.com) Ludovico Einaudi's album 'Una Mattina' (Decca) is dated 2004, (P) 2004 Ludovico Einaudi, 13 tracks, and lists 'Nuvole Bianche'.

Ludovico Einaudi's album 'In a Time Lapse' is dated January 1, 2013, 19 songs, (P) 2013 Ludovico Einaudi under exclusive licence to Decca, and names the track 'Experience' (violin solo by Daniel Hope).

(search-result snippet from music.apple.com) 'Comptine d'un autre ete, l'apres-midi' by Yann Tiersen is listed on the album 'Le Fabuleux destin d'Amelie Poulain (Bande originale du film)', dated April 23, 2001.

'Gabriel's Oboe (From "The Mission")' is listed by Ennio Morricone with the Czech National Symphony Orchestra on 'Morricone - The Maestro (Secret Morricone)', dated November 11, 2016 (a later recording). The page also lists the album 'The Mission (Original Sound Track from the Film)'; its date was not read.

'Love Theme (From "Cinema Paradiso")' is listed by Ennio Morricone with the Orchestra dell'Accademia Nazionale di Santa Cecilia on 'Morricone conducts Morricone - His Greatest Hits', dated 1 January 1999 (a later recording); Andrea Morricone is credited as composer.

(search-result snippet from music.apple.com) 'Married Life' by Michael Giacchino is listed as a single dated 2024, (P) 2024, and the artist page lists 'Up (Soundtrack from the Motion Picture)'; the original soundtrack release date was not shown.

'Merry-Go-Round of Life (From "Howl's Moving Castle")' is listed by Joe Hisaishi with the Royal Philharmonic Orchestra on 'A Symphonic Celebration (Music from the Studio Ghibli Films of Hayao Miyazaki)', dated 31 March 2023 (a later recording).
'Arrival of the Birds' by The Cinematic Orchestra is listed on 'The Crimson Wing: Mystery of the Flamingos (Original Soundtrack)', dated 1 January 2008.
(search-result snippet from music.apple.com) 'Can't Help Falling In Love' by Elvis Presley is listed on 'Blue Hawaii (Original Soundtrack)', dated October 1, 1961.
(search-result snippet from music.apple.com) 'Here Comes the Sun (Take 9)' by The Beatles is listed on 'Abbey Road (Super Deluxe Edition) [2019 Remix & Remaster]', dated 26 September 1969.

(search-result snippet from music.apple.com) 'Turning Page - Single' by Sleeping At Last is dated 18 June 2012, (P) 2012 Sleeping At Last; a 'Turning Page (Instrumental)' is listed on 'The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn, Pt. 1 (Original Motion Picture Soundtrack)'.
Bob Dylan's album 'Time Out of Mind' is dated September 30, 1997, 11 songs, (P) 1997 Sony Music Entertainment Inc., and the album notes name 'Make You Feel My Love' as one of its songs.

(search-result snippet from music.apple.com) 'I Choose You' by Sara Bareilles is track 9 on 'The Blessed Unrest', dated 16 July 2013, 12 songs, (P) 2013 Epic Records, a division of Sony Music Entertainment.
